**Overall Sentiment:** The balance sheet shows modest improvements in some areas (asset and equity growth), but the concerning drop in profitability and the increased debt-to-equity ratio are powerful negatives. The sentiment is therefore negative, leaning towards a score of -0.75, reflecting the dominance of the profit loss in the assessment.
